exposure: mode of delivery (PVD vs. planned CS)
outcome: rate of breech presentation at delivery
rate of caesarean section (CS) due to breech presentation
rate of admissions to the neonatal unit
cohort: 2377 singleton breech pregnancies at term at the Obstetrics and Gynaecology Service, Cruces University Hospital (Biscay, Spain), from January 2003 to December 2012
finding: Management of breech presentation with ECV and planned vaginal delivery significantly decreased the rate of CS for breech presentation, without significant differences in neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Early postnatal parameters (5-min Apgar score, umbilical cord arterial pH and acid-base analysis) were significantly lower following PVD compared with planned CS for breech presentation.
